_readme: SOURCES.json — which Kenney kit model each .glb beside it started life as.
WHY IT IS AUTHORED AND NOT DERIVED. Almost none of these files are the kit's
bytes any more: the cacti and palms lost a stray export parent, the snow trees
were re-pointed at a live colormap, and every car has been split, flipped or
given an axle. Names moved too (tree_palmTall -> palm-tall). So there is no
hash and no name rule that recovers the origin — a car whose first mesh is
'wheel-bl' matches four other cars — and provenance is a thing someone knows,
writes down once, and a gate then keeps honest.
WHAT READS IT. The asset gallery's kit browser (`npm run fetch:kits`, then tick
Kit browser) joins this against all ~585 models in the three kits, so the ones
already in the game are marked and the rest are what is left to choose from.
tests/asset-sources.test.js is the gate: every .glb here is listed, and nothing
`kit` ids are scripts/fetch-kits.mjs's; the licenses and versions are
public/shared/credits.js and KENNEY-License.txt. This file re-declares neither.
`generated` means there is no kit model at all — the source is the script.
